items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: I went to a friend, Bob of mine. He played drums. His name was, we always call him Neneet, but his name was, Bryant.

ctx.x: If you have any other pictures of some of the bands you played in, I'd like to see those too. What's your name?

Well, when I was around the age, when I got around 16 years old, I had a, I used to go around with boys, most of my friends, you know, they had a few that played piano. And one boy I remember with a fine violin playing. In other words, he could play most any of the string instruments. Yes. The guitar, the violin, and the mandolin. You see? And I would be with these boys so often, till a lot of people thought I could play, although they never saw me with instruments, you know? You see? So, one day somebody asked…
